items.title: Ken Peplowski interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I’m talking to this clarinet player Marty Ehrlich about doing some recording together

ctx.x: So I’ve been talking a lot to some of those guys. In fact I’m talking to this clarinet player Marty Ehrlich about doing some recording together and trying to find a common bond. I love doing that. It’s a challenge for me because I like their music a lot and it’s good sometimes to test myself and see what I can bring to that kind of music. So anyway, when I first moved to New York that also was a huge big experience for me. And there’s a few highlights like that I could talk about. Working with Benny Goodman, of…
